purpose: Measure whether a strategy produces decision-relevant, robust and executable value without creating another governance chain or silently inventing execution assumptions.

event_level_metric_policy.out_of_sample: Only report upstream-frozen sample_partition; never assign or reshuffle train/OOS membership.
event_level_metric_policy.drawdown: Forbidden on unordered event observations. Use the portfolio-path evaluator only when a chronological executed exposure path is explicitly supplied.

portfolio_path_policy.principle: Evaluator measures an upstream execution-resolved path and does not infer holding period, fills, weights, leverage, costs, benchmark or untradable-order behavior.
portfolio_path_policy.annualization: No implicit periods-per-year or risk-free assumption. Annualized metrics require explicit experiment inputs.

hard_integrity_boundary: No future leakage or outcome contamination.
No silent classifier or threshold change.
No timestamp ambiguity that can alter inference.
No sample identity ambiguity that can alter inference.
No hidden portfolio-construction or execution assumptions.
explicit_non_goals: Does not authorize V2.8.12 prospective E-event outcome research before its readiness gate.
Does not convert diagnostic metrics into evidence strength before a separately frozen threshold contract exists.
